old_text: Cincinnati Parks says a long sloped interior walkway gives universal access to the Palm House and the waterfall.
text: A July 26, 2020 Cincinnati Parks article describes a long sloped interior walkway to the Palm House and waterfall. This is a historical description, not a current route or gradient assessment.
quote: Cincinnati’s iconic flora center features a long sloped interior walkway, which provides universal access to the Palm House and the waterfall.
reason: Dated the older article and removed an unqualified current universal-access characterization.

old_text: Cincinnati Parks says the Gale garden at Krohn was made accessible.
text: Cincinnati Parks Foundation describes a 2019 Betty Gale Garden project that added a level concrete walk and adjusted inlets. The retrospective does not establish the garden’s current surface condition or an uninterrupted route from parking.
quote: CPF stewarded a gift that reopened a long-closed section of Krohn Conservatory, the Betty Gale Garden. The garden was made fully accessible with a new, level concrete walk and adjusted inlets. (2019)
reason: Replaced a broad undated access label with attributable physical changes and the historical project year.

old_text: Krohn's phone is 513-421-4086, and it is occasionally closed for private events, so check the events calendar. Cincinnati Parks takes accommodation requests by form; questions go to 513-357-2604.
text: Cincinnati Parks accepts reasonable-accommodation requests through its linked request form. Questions about accommodations go to 513-357-2604.
quote: Cincinnati Parks is committed to providing a quality experience at all our parks and facilities by providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request. To request an accommodation fill out a Reasonable Accommodation Request Form linked here.
reason: Removed the Krohn phone and private-event closure clauses that were not supported by this source; they are retained separately against the actual facility page.
